team.target: regular-season score margin; historical unconditional total score

residualDecomposition.method: method of moments; approximate independent opponent effects

team.simulationTransition: Use previous realized mean scoring margin once through strengthCoefficient; add team-season shock and game noise. Update prior from simulated PF-PA per game; do not apply persistence again.
limitations: Team-season shock decomposition assumes approximately independent opponent effects.
Stationary total-score distribution does not model future scoring shifts.
No player-to-wins causal effect is identified.
